# Mohd Nasir

> Portfolio of Mohd Nasir, a Software Engineer at Tally Solutions in Bengaluru, India, with 2+ years of experience in C++. He works on core software components, memory management, multithreading and performance improvement. Everything below is also stated on the site itself.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://mohdnasir.site/): introduction, highlights, about, experience, skills, projects, competitive programming, education and contact.
- [Engineering Lab](https://mohdnasir.site/lab/): 6 interactive experiments covering 34 algorithms (page replacement, CPU scheduling, memory allocation, sorting, searching and graph algorithms). Everything runs in the browser, step by step.
- [Writing](https://mohdnasir.site/writing/): short, plain-language notes on operating systems and algorithms, with one post for each algorithm in the Engineering Lab.

## Facts

- Role: Software Engineer at Tally Solutions (since September 2024).
- Focus: C and C++, systems programming, memory management, concurrency and performance optimisation.
- Education: B.Tech in Computer Science, Graphic Era Deemed to be University.
- Competitive programming: 1,700+ LeetCode problems solved, highest contest rating 1989, Knight badge, Coding Ninjas AIR 3, HackWithInfy 2024 Top 100 finalist.
- Work at Tally Solutions is part of internal company projects, so its source code and detailed implementation are not public.
